authelia:
# Generated by Marineris. Do not edit: changes are overwritten.
access_control:
    default_policy: deny
    rules:
        - domain:
            - hello.mars.example
            - mars.example
            - nas.mars.example
          policy: two_factor
authentication_backend:
    file:
        password:
            algorithm: argon2
            argon2:
                iterations: 3
                key_length: 32
                memory: 65536
                parallelism: 4
                salt_length: 16
                variant: argon2id
        path: /config/users_database.yml
        watch: true
    password_reset:
        disable: true
log:
    format: json
    level: info
notifier:
    disable_startup_check: true
    filesystem:
        filename: /notifications/notification.txt
ntp:
    disable_startup_check: true
password_policy:
    standard:
        enabled: true
        max_length: 256
        min_length: 12
regulation:
    ban_time: 30m
    find_time: 10m
    max_retries: 5
server:
    address: tcp://:9091/
    disable_healthcheck: true
session:
    cookies:
        - authelia_url: https://auth.mars.example
          domain: mars.example
        - authelia_url: https://auth.valles.example
          domain: valles.example
    expiration: 12h
    inactivity: 30m
    name: marineris_auth_session
    remember_me: -1
    same_site: lax
storage:
    local:
        path: /data/db.sqlite3
theme: dark
totp:
    algorithm: SHA1
    digits: 6
    issuer: Marineris
    period: 30
    skew: 1
webauthn:
    attestation_conveyance_preference: indirect
    disable: false
    display_name: Marineris
    enable_passkey_login: true
    selection_criteria:
        discoverability: preferred
        user_verification: preferred
    timeout: 60s
